Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1344
Claimant:
Karen Melendez
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
February 12, 2024
Claim opened for a parking lot collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck while stopped. The claimant reports
a knee injury and is represented by counsel, so all contact will go through the attorney's office.
February 22, 2024
Confirmed the drvier is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
April 11, 2024
Police report and two statements confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact. No independent
witnesses have come forward to describe the collision itself.
May 6, 2024
Reviewed scene photos. They confirm the general location and point of contact, though the lot camera did not
capture the moment of impact.
May 22, 2024
Reviewed the photos of the vehicles. A few old scratches appear on the rear bumper and may be older than this
crash, so the repair estimate is being checked against them.
June 21, 2024
The claimant's first statement was given to the attorney's office. Later the claimant added smaller details about seat
position and the seconds before impact, but the core account has not changed.
July 4, 2024
Medical records show a knee injury that is plausible for a low-speed impact of this kind. No prior injury to the same
area appears in the records we have requested.
July 22, 2024
Treatment followed a typical course of therapy and tapered off as the claimant improved. The most recent records
describe a steady recovery.
September 8, 2024
The medical provider and the damage estimate do not yet fully line up. It is unclear whether all of the vehicle damage
and the injury came from this single impact, so the question has been sent to the appraiser and the treating provider.
September 13, 2024
Reserve reviewed and kept in place pending the appraiser's supplemental findings and the attorney's response to our
request for records. Next review is scheduled once thsoe are received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
